item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Fighting has resumed in the Kherson region after the longest ceasefire ended, and Russian drones struck a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13. Russian forces are now fitting makeshift armor of nets and rubber tires to shadow-fleet drones and using decoy drones for one-way attacks up to 1,200 km, while both Ukrainian hackers and Russian actors have compromised emergency alert apps to issue fake nuclear warnings. A Russian Su‑57 fighter was destroyed by an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield, and Russian troops have used the Oleshky ceasefire to mask movements. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
